caption: The drawing shows a statue of a human figure standing on a gray rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a yellow tunic with a geometric border at the hem and short sleeves, covered by a red robe draped over the left shoulder and upper body. The figure is wearing brown sandals. Around the neck are two necklaces, one large and beaded with a prominent pendant. A headband, also yellow, is worn across the forehead, and attached to it are five upright brown feathers. The figure's skin tone is medium brown. The left hand is holding a small dark object, while the right hand is resting on the stomach with fingers extended. The overall background is plain and off-white, with the focus solely on the statue.
title: Cigar Store Indian
